# Cli Std Agent Context

> TD-first map for agents. Start from tech design and capability intent before implementation files.

- [Tech Design](tech-design): implementation source of truth.
- Validate: `aw td check libs/cli-std/tech-design`.

## Capability Map

- [README](README.md): capability source of truth and product contract.

## Agent Workflow

- Capability next action: `aw capability next --project cli-std`.
- Readiness: `aw health --project cli-std`.
- Blockers: `aw health --project cli-std blockers`.

## Commands

- Test: `cargo test -p cli-std`.
